_meta.description: Collated Brighton gig data Fri 15 – Sun 17 May 2026. Aggregated from BMB unofficial-gigs blog, rivalcults.com/gigs, 4x Haiku scrape batches (non-IG venue pages), Sonnet retry pass (Skiddle/Songkick/venue sites), Clashfinder tge26. IG captions still to come from local Playwright run.
_meta.official_TGE_filter: Events whose name contains 'The Great Escape' or whose primary link is greatescapefestival.com have been EXCLUDED per user request. Same venue can still host unofficial events (e.g. Hope & Ruin runs TGE programmes AND No Friends in the Industry).
